EncoderProfile RotaryWidgetClass {
  Delta=0.003
  Increase=[ 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07, 0x08 ]

  Quantize=Floor
  ValueOffset=1
  Style Dot Code=0 Steps=11
  Style BoostCut Code=1 Steps=11
  Style Fill Code=2 Steps=11
  Style Spread Code=3 Steps=6
}
